bias.en: Rebound fading · lost $110–112.7, on the Nov 6 close
bias.zh: 反弹减弱 · 跌破 $110–112.7，位于 11月6日收盘价

read.en: Corning fell 6.9% on Nov 16 to $106.17, trading $105.41–109.84. It is below the 5-day ($114.5), 10-day ($114.3), 30-day ($130.0), 100-day ($152.9) and 200-day ($156.6). MACD has been above its signal since Nov 12, below zero, histogram almost closed (a cross down is close); Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Nov 11 ($103.13), and RSI is 35.9.

The drop broke the $110.1–112.7 supports (Nov 10, 12 and 13 lows), now resistance; the close sits on the Nov 6 close ($106.13). Resistance is $107.9–109.8 (Nov 9 low, Nov 16 high), then $110.1–112.7 and $114.1–114.5 (Nov 13 close, 10 and 5-day). Support is $104.1–106.1 (Nov 6), then $101.8–103.1 (Nov 5 low, SAR). A close above $109.8 would target $110–112.7; below $104.1, $101.8–103.1.
